title: Integration
raw_text:
9/30/26, 5:12 AM
You can allocate logical registers or installations to a technical point of delivery. If you do this, the allocation applies

to all the registers contained in the installation.

A technical point of delivery distinguishes between the following point of delivery categories :

=» Normal point of delivery category

« Virtual point of delivery category

A virtual point of delivery category is a summary of several normal point of delivery categories. For example,
the virtual point of delivery category can summarize the consumption of the normal point of delivery

categories.

In Customizing, you define point of delivery types and allocate these to the SAP predefined point of delivery

categories.

Integration

The graphic below depicts the integration of the point of delivery in the IS-U data model.
